sloka: आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठन्ति तैः च सूर्यो अभिपूजितः ।अदृश्यः सर्व भूतानाम् अस्तम् गच्छति पर्वतम् ॥४-४२-४२॥
transliteration: ādityam upatiṣṭhanti taiḥ ca sūryo abhipūjitaḥ ।adṛśyaḥ sarva bhūtānām astam gacchati parvatam ॥4-42-42॥

translations.english: The Visvadevas, Vasus, Maruts, and the gods reach Meru, this great king of mountains, in the evening twilight. Worshipped by them, the Sungod sets behind the mountain and becomes invisible to all beings.
